extraction.notes: The official site has posted its 2027 program list and schedule; 2026-only offerings are omitted, including First Camp, First Camp - Music Week, Soak & Soar Explorers, Soak & Soar Mountaineers, and Gathering Expedition Camp. Attempts to open additional individual program pages and the cost page returned no readable content. Most cards therefore use the supplied official 2027 summer-camp overview, including its explicitly labeled starting prices. No registration opening date was found. Registration is directed to the official registration landing page because the CampWise destination could not be retrieved.
